svg.title: 9-Layer Medical AI System Architecture
svg.desc: Full stack medical AI with Flutter mobile, FastAPI, LangGraph agents, LLM layer, RAG pipeline, security, observability, and data layers

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Tell me about the Flutter mobile app architecture for medical AI')
sendPrompt('Tell me about the React web portal for medical AI')
sendPrompt('How does the camera and video stream work for remote monitoring?')
sendPrompt('What wearable IoT sensors are supported for remote patient monitoring?')
